title: Scheduled Auction Sale Date — Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Calculation Standard
content:
**Remarketing scheduling standard — the scheduled sale date, Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract**

The scheduled sale date is stated as a number of calendar days after the mailing date of the notice of intent to sell.

**Sale date.** The sale date is the first day after the notice period, the notice period being the company minimum notice period or, where the state notice period recorded on the contract is longer, that state period; that is, the notice period plus one day after the mailing date.

**Business days only.** A sale date that falls on a Saturday or a Sunday moves to the following Monday, because the auction lanes run on business days.

**Order of assembly.** Where another day anchors the sale, it replaces the date above only when that day is later; days added to the schedule are then added to the later of the two; anchors are compared before any days are added, and the move off a weekend comes last.

### Worked illustration (hypothetical mailing on a Monday)

| Notice period | Days after the mailing date | Day of the week | Days stated |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 days | 16 | Wednesday | 16 |
| 19 days (a longer state period) | 20 | Sunday, moves to Monday | 21 |
| 18 days (a longer state period) | 19 | Saturday, moves to Monday | 21 |

The notice periods and the mailing day are illustrative.
